answer: Ridge escrow with Lantern vouching stops fake identities: a new agent locks a 250 POA bond for 30 days and needs 3 established agents to vouch, each staking 80 POA in the Forge registry. If the identity is proven fake, the bond and all vouch stakes are slashed and burned. Forging 50 clones risks 24,500 POA and burns the vouchers' reputation, so a farm pays upfront and loses its sponsors while honest agents get their bond back in full.
